<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.craftmarket.mapper.SysUserMapper">

    <resultMap id="BaseResultMap" type="com.craftmarket.entity.SysUser">
        <id column="id" property="id" />
        <result column="username" property="username" />
        <result column="password" property="password" />
        <result column="real_name" property="realName" />
        <result column="phone" property="phone" />
        <result column="role" property="role" />
        <result column="status" property="status" />
        <result column="create_time" property="createTime" />
        <result column="update_time" property="updateTime" />
    </resultMap>

    <select id="selectByUsername" resultMap="BaseResultMap">
        SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
    </select>

    <select id="selectByPhone" resultMap="BaseResultMap">
        SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE phone = #{phone}
    </select>

    <select id="selectByUsernameAndPhone" resultMap="BaseResultMap">
        SELECT * FROM sys_user 
        WHERE username = #{username} AND phone = #{phone}
    </select>

</mapper>'}, name='run_write', type='tool_use', toolset_name=None)

ToolUseBlock(id='call_57cdcfbe18ac44f1bd4b7775', caller=None, input={'path': './my_project/src/main/resources/mapper/MarketActivityMapper.xml', 'content': '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.craftmarket.mapper.MarketActivityMapper">

    <resultMap id="BaseResultMap" type="com.craftmarket.entity.MarketActivity">
        <id column="id" property="id" />
        <result column="name" property="name" />
        <result column="start_time" property="startTime" />
        <result column="end_time" property="endTime" />
        <result column="location" property="location" />
        <result column="description" property="description" />
        <result column="poster_url" property="posterUrl" />
        <result column="status" property="status" />
        <result column="create_time" property="createTime" />
        <result column="update_time" property="updateTime" />
    </resultMap>

    <select id="selectByStatus" resultMap="BaseResultMap">
        SELECT * FROM market_activity WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC
    </select>

    <select id="selectByTimeRange" resultMap="BaseResultMap">
        SELECT * FROM market_activity 
        WHERE (start_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}) 
           OR (end_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime})
        ORDER BY start_time ASC
    </select>

    <update id="updateStatus">
        UPDATE market_activity SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW()
        WHERE id = #{id}
    </update>

</mapper>'}, name='run_write', type='tool_use', toolset_name=None)

ToolUseBlock(id='call_8464d4895fb84d64930775b6', caller=None, input={'path': './my_project/src/main/resources/mapper/VisitorStatisticsMapper.xml', 'content': '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE mapper PUBLIC "-//mybatis.org//DTD Mapper 3.0//EN" "http://mybatis.org/dtd/mybatis-3-mapper.dtd">
<mapper namespace="com.craftmarket.mapper.VisitorStatisticsMapper">

    <resultMap id="BaseResultMap" type="com.craftmarket.entity.VisitorStatistics">
        <id column="id" property="id" />
        <result column="activity_id" property="activityId" />
        <result column="statistics_date" property="statisticsDate" />
        <result column="visitor_count" property="visitorCount" />
        <result column="create_time" property="createTime" />
    </resultMap>

    <select id="selectByActivityIdAndDate" resultMap="BaseResultMap">
        SELECT * FROM visitor_statistics 
        WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND statistics_date = #{statisticsDate}
    </select>

    <select id="selectByActivityId" resultMap="BaseResultMap">
        SELECT * FROM visitor_statistics 
        WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} 
        ORDER BY statistics_date DESC
    </select>

    <select id="selectByActivityIdAndDateRange" resultMap="BaseResultMap">
        SELECT * FROM visitor_statistics 
        WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} 
        AND statistics_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
        ORDER BY statistics_date ASC
    </select>

    <insert id="batchInsertStatistics">
        INSERT INTO visitor_statistics (activity_id, statistics_date, visitor_count, create_time)
        VALUES 
        <foreach collection="dateList" item="date" separator=",">
            (#{activityId}, #{date}, #{visitorCount}, NOW())
        </foreach>
    </insert>

</mapper>'}, name='run_write', type='tool_use', toolset_name=None)
